statements.status_notes: This advisory is an informational notice that proc-macro-error2 is unmaintained. In uv 0.13.7, its only dependency parent is defmt-macros 1.1.0, a procedural-macro crate compiled for the build host. The helper executes during macro expansion and its code is not linked into the installed uv or uvx executables; its presence in the auditable dependency inventory does not make it runtime code. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0173.html and https://docs.rs/crate/defmt-macros/1.1.0/source/Cargo.toml.
